# Design System Inspiration of Market

## 1. Visual Theme & Atmosphere
Market is a sober trading tool centered on real inventory.

## 2. Color Palette & Roles
Red is reserved for the highest-intent transaction.

## 3. Typography
Hierarchy is driven by three deliberate weights.

## 4. Iconography & Imagery
Seller images remain heterogeneous inside consistent crops.

## 5. Spacing, Radius & Elevation
Borders and tints establish depth without generic shadows.

## 6. Layout & Grid
The inventory grid is mobile-first.

## 7. z-index Tokens
Transient feedback sits above drawers.

## 8. Components — atomic anatomy
Product cards keep price, title, metadata, and save action together.

## 9. Microcopy & Voice
Use direct transaction language.

## 10. Patterns & Anti-Patterns
Do not decorate actions with unrelated accent colors.

## 11. Brand Voice Summary
Fast, precise, and unembellished.

## 12. When to draw inspiration from Market
Use this system for inventory-heavy marketplace work.

## 13. Do's and Don'ts
Do keep transaction status visible.
